ext_description.message: Combine multiple images and PDFs into one PNG or PDF to save and share. Everything is processed on this PC.

app_subtitle.description: Small subtitle next to the Pic Merge title. Empty in English: no subtitle (DESIGN 2.2).

html_lang.description: BCP 47 tag of this translation, used for the html lang attribute. Not shown.

empty_title.message: Choose at least 2 images to merge

empty_text.message: The layout direction is chosen automatically.

drop_hint.message: You can also drop JPEG, PNG, WebP and PDF files onto this page.

percent_value.description: $1 = percent value, shown on the image size and margin settings

preview_note_horizontal.message: PNG joins the pages from left to right into one file, with a gray line between images. PDF saves each page separately, without lines.

preview_note_vertical.message: PNG joins the pages from top to bottom into one file, with a gray line between images. PDF saves each page separately, without lines.

preview_note_original.message: This is the PNG preview. PNG has a gray line between images. PDF saves one page per image, without lines.

save_hint.message: Choose at least 2 images to save.

drop_overlay.message: Drop here to add to the list

progress_hint.message: Large images can take tens of seconds.

progress_keep_tab.message: Keep this tab open until it finishes.

share_format_title.message: Which format do you want to share?

share_unavailable.message: Chrome on this PC does not support the file share window. Download or copy the file, then send it.

share_note.message: On a PC you cannot send directly to KakaoTalk or text messages. If the app appears in the OS share window opened by 'Share', you can choose it there. After 'Copy image', a PNG can be pasted into a KakaoTalk PC chat. 'Compose email' downloads the file and opens your mail app; you attach the file yourself.

snack_max_images.message: You can add up to $1 images.

snack_unsupported.message: Files excluded because their format is not supported: $1

snack_over_limit.message: You can add up to $1 images, so only $2 were added.
snack_over_limit.description: $1 = maximum number of images, $2 = number actually added

clear_confirm.message:
Remove all selected images from the list?
The original files are not deleted.

crashed_title.message: The previous save did not finish

crashed_message.message: The previous save ended midway. Keep the app open until saving finishes. If this keeps happening, use fewer images.

history_rate_none.message: No saves in the last $1 days.

error_unsupported_format.message: An image has an unsupported format.

error_source_unavailable.message: Cannot open an image. Please choose it again.

error_source_unavailable_n.message: Cannot open image $1. Please choose it again.

error_output_too_large.message: The output file is too large. Use fewer images.

error_out_of_memory.message: Out of memory. Use fewer images.

item_drag_label.message: Reorder item $1. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it

copy_png_only.message: Only PNG can be copied as an image.

mail_body.message: Please attach the file you just downloaded ($1) to this email.

snack_share_failed.message: Cannot open the share window. Download the file, then send it.

snack_copied.message: Image copied. You can paste it into KakaoTalk or an email.

snack_copy_failed.message: Could not copy the image. Download it, then send it.

snack_mail.message: File downloaded. Please attach $1 to the email.

error_folder_unavailable.message: Can't access the save folder. Please choose a folder again.

folder_pick_failed.message: Couldn't choose a folder. Please try again.
